name: Frozen
source: A Frozen type monster girl. Leo sees this Frozen wandering the pyramid on Squid Island looking for her dog Shiro-chan. A very polite Yamato Nadeshiko type monster girl she only attacks [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] because she's worried that if he captures her she won't find Shiro-chan.
